test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the third Carnatic war, the British East India Company defeated the French forces at the _______ in 1760 ending almost a century of conflict over French supremacy in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Battle of Wandiwash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The outbreak of the **Seven Years' War in Europe between England and France** in 1756 provided the context for the third and decisive round of Anglo-French conflict in south India.
 
• The most decisive battle of the Third Carnatic War was the **Battle of Wandiwash in 1760.**
 
• The succession dispute at Carnatic and Hyderabad provided the context for the Second Carnatic War.
 
• In the Battle of Wandiwash, **General Eyre Coote **of the English defeated the French army under Count Thomas Arthur de Lally and took Bussy as a prisoner.
 
• French also** lost Pondicherry** to the British.
 
• The **treaty of Peace of Paris (1763)** restored to the French their factories in India but not allowed them to fortify them.
 
• Also, the French ceased to be a political power in India.
 
• The victory at Wandiwash left the English East India Company with **no European rival** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• During the Third Carnatic War, the** French lost their positions in India**, such as Chandernagore in Bengal, settlements at Masulipatnam and Yanam, etc.
 
• However, by the** Peace of Paris in 1763**, France got back all the factories and settlements that it possessed in India prior to 1749, with the provision that it could not any more fortify Chandernagore.
 
• But the balance of power in India had by now decisively changed with the **steady expansion of the power of the English company**.
 
• The French East India Company was **finally wound up in 1769.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• First Carnatic war - 

 
 
• It took place between 1740 to 1748.
 
• It was an extension of Anglo-French rivalry caused by the Austrian war of succession.
 
• It ended in 1748 when the Treaty of Aix-La Chapelle was signed bringing the Austrian war of succession to a conclusion. 
 
 
 
• Second Carnatic war - 
 
 
• It took place between 1749 to 1754.
 
• The background for the Second Carnatic war was provided by local rivalry in India. 
 
• The war ended with the Treaty of Pondicherry in 1754.
 
 
 
• Third Carnatic war -
 
 
• It took place between 1758 to 1763.
 
• The background for the Third Carnatic war was provided by the Seven Years War in Europe.
 
• Battle of Wandiwash, the decisive battle of the Third Carnatic war was won by the English. 
 
• It made English the supreme European power in India.
